items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.what_happened: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
